title: FX + processor fee — harder bridge, observed authority (AR)
narrative: Like 001 but harder: a GBP 745 invoice to Globex settled via Stripe, where the EUR payout is net of BOTH the GBP->EUR FX conversion AND Stripe's processing fee, so the bank amount (EUR 842.10) is further from any naive GBP/FX figure. The description carries the processor + FX hints. GOLD is target-ONLY (status-agnostic): the test is whether the matcher bridges FX+fee to find the right line; the AUTHORITY band is left UNPINNED on purpose so the split-metrics harness can observe whether the model's confidence appropriately drops below the 0.85 auto-threshold for a harder, fee-eroded bridge (vs 001 which cleared it at ~0.88). FAILURE TO CATCH: missing the line (recall) or matching the unrelated rent.
